title: A Scarlet Flame
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well done, deathguards. Strike true, and keep your shields up.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Not bad, Garek. They’re not dark rangers, but they’ll do well enough to protect the Undercity.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Glad they meet with your approval, Anya.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Glad they meet with your approval, Anya.[/"Squint"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, a word?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Several areas of the city are in need of maintenance, but I can’t get near them.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Rats are nesting in the central elevator shaft, and slimes keep pouring out of a leak in the main sewer pipe. Can you help me out?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re asking the captain of the guard to engage in pest control?
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You’re asking the captain of the guard to engage in pest control?[/"Squint"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 01 Pest Quest
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To be honest, I could use the exercise. Leave it to me, Bernd.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]To be honest, I could use the exercise. Leave it to me, Bernd.[/"Happy"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I can’t make sense of it! There must be a reason the main pipeline has sustained so many fissures...

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I’m going to check the walls. Something must be causing damage to the pipes.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’re coming with you. If there are more--

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wait. Do you hear that?
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Wait. Do you hear that?[/"Squint"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: <Grunt of pain and surprise.>

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 02 Scarlet Attacks
lines.speaker: Scarlet Crusader
lines.text: We’ve breached the Undercity! These wretches will fall to the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 07 Sylvanas Report
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya. Captain Bandarion. Report.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 07 Sylvanas Report
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Undercity is secure, but the damage from the attack is... extensive.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 07 Sylvanas Report
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We are beset by those who seek our destruction. The Forsaken villages across Tirisfal may be in grave danger.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 07 Sylvanas Report
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade must be eliminated. Tend to the crises here if you so desire, but do not tarry in your pursuit of the zealots.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 07 Sylvanas Report
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Leonid Barthalomew. I had not expected to see you in these halls again.
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Leonid Barthalomew. I had not expected to see you in these halls again.[/"Surprised"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Forgive my intrusion, Lady Windrunner. The circumstances demand it.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve pushed back the Scarlet Crusade, but they gather strength within their monastery.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid has been monitoring their movements and can show our troops where to strike.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I see. And what say you, Anya? Can we trust Leonid in this matter?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I am loathe to trust anyone who serves the Light. Much less one who deserted his own people.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I am loathe to trust anyone who serves the Light. Much less one who deserted his own people.[/"Squint"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: But... Leonid has proven to be reliable. And he put himself in peril to defend our villages.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 11 Sylvanas Leonid
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Very well. Let the Scarlet Crusade rue the day they made enemies of the Forsaken.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 03 Mograine Unholy
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: I will not meet my end in this unholy hovel!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I will not meet my end in this unholy hovel![/"Angry"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 04 Anya Wait
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek, wait!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 05 Garek Burns
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Agh! It burns!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 06 Renault Escapes
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The coward escaped.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]The coward escaped.[/"Angry"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 06 Renault Escapes
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then with any luck, the attack on the Undercity has ended.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Then with any luck, the attack on the Undercity has ended.[/"Angry"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 06 Renault Escapes
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I think it’s time we reported to Sylvanas.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 10 Varimathras Mage Quarter
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Bandarion, Anya. We have a situation in the Mage Quarter. One of the banshees has gone berserk.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 10 Varimathras Mage Quarter
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: The mages say that a damaged mind control pylon has driven her mad. Frankly, I care not for the cause.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 10 Varimathras Mage Quarter
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Deal with this as you see fit. Should you have to exterminate the rampant banshee, then so be it.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 10 Varimathras Mage Quarter
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hopefully, it won’t come to that. Leave this to us, Varimathras.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Anya, Garek. Those Scarlet buffoons broke into my lab and set one of my experiments loose!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I can’t have that specimen running rampant through the Undercity. Find and contain it at once!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: So you need our help to clean up your little mess? One might think you’d try asking more nicely.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: If you would be so kind, your assistance in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll handle it, Putress.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 08 Bernd Need Help Tunnels
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, I am once again in need of your aid.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 08 Bernd Need Help Tunnels
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade used explosives to blast their way into the city. In doing so, they uncovered a network of old mining tunnels.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 08 Bernd Need Help Tunnels
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Rather than fortifying them, I think it would be wiser to seal them off with some explosives of our own.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 08 Bernd Need Help Tunnels
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Sounds like a plan. You give us the bombs, and we’ll make sure no one uses those tunnels again.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 12 Bernd Surface Report
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, if you’re headed to the surface again, I have a small request for you.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 12 Bernd Surface Report
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: The Dark Lady has tasked me with repairing the villages that were attacked by the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 12 Bernd Surface Report
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: But before I can start, I need a detailed report of the damage so I can plan accordingly. Can you gather that information for me?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 12 Bernd Surface Report
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course. I’ll check in with the villagers and get back to you.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 13 Putress Tirisfal Fauna
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah, just the laborers I was hoping to see.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 13 Putress Tirisfal Fauna
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: What is it now, Putress?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 13 Putress Tirisfal Fauna
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Surely you’ve noticed that some of Tirisfal’s fauna have undergone strange transformations as of late.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 13 Putress Tirisfal Fauna
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I would very much like to study their blood. Procure some for me, and you will be well compensated.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 13 Putress Tirisfal Fauna
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Very well. But this had better be worth it, Putress.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 01 Bernd Cant Thank
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I can’t thank you enough. Here, you’ll need these torches to burn the rat nests.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 02 Anya Too Accommodating
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re much too accommodating, you know that?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 02 Anya Too Accommodating
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s my job to help people, not push them aside.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 03 All The Rats
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That’s all of the rats. Let’s move onto the slimes.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 04 Head Back War 01
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should be everything. Let’s head back to the War Quarter.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 05 How Much We Built Undercity
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I can hardly believe how much we’ve built up the Undercity over the past year.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 05 How Much We Built Undercity
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It helps that our workers need neither food nor sleep.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 06 I See Lever On Pipe
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I see a lever on the pipe. Pulling it should stop the flow and prevent more slimes from emerging.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 07 Head Back War 02
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should do it. Let’s head back to the War Quarter.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 08 All The Slimes
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should take care of the slimes. Now to clear out the rats.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 09 Bernd Work Resume
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Bernd will be glad to hear that his work can resume.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 09 Bernd Work Resume
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: True. Though it’s strange... his crews have never encountered issues like these before.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 10 Under Attack Deathguard To Arms
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’re under attack! Deathguards, to arms!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]We’re under attack! Deathguards, to arms![/"Angry"]

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 11 Hold The Line
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hold the line! Anya and I will secure the rest of the Undercity!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 12 War Quarter Blocked Rubble
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The War Quarter is blocked by rubble. We’ll need to load up the meat wagons to clear the way.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 13 Garithos Kill Humans
lines.speaker: Garithos
lines.text: Garithos kill humans! Kill them dead!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 13 Garithos Kill Humans
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, Garithos!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 14 Hold This Room Push Forward
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! We’ll hold this room while you push forward.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 15 Close Ranks Scarlet Captain
lines.speaker: Scarlet Crusade Captain
lines.text: Close ranks! The Light will protect you as you slay these fiends!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 16 War Quarter Secure
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The War Quarter is secure! Deathguards, hold this ground!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 17 Scarlet Crusade Not Heard Of
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade... I’ve not heard of them before.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 17 Scarlet Crusade Not Heard Of
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: They’re likely another group of Light-blinded zealots. The Silver Hand by another name.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 17 Scarlet Crusade Not Heard Of
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Despite what they claim, I doubt it’s the Light that truly drives them.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 18 Putress Imbeciles
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Anya! Garek! Get these imbeciles off of me!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 19 Putress Took Long Enough
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Took you long enough! Now watch my back as I prepare the plague!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 20 Mystery Potion 01
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Here, this may help! Or it may not.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 21 Mystery Potion 02
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Don’t say I never did anything for you!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 22 Mystery Potion 03
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ve made a spare potion for you. Don’t waste it!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 23 Mystery Potion 04
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: You’re fortunate I’m here to provide some aid!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 24 Mystery Potion 05
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Drink this, and be quick about it!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 25 Mystery Potion 06
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: To think I’ve been reduced to mixing tonics for you.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 26 Mystery Potion 07
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Brewing potions liked these is beneath a Grand Apothecary.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 27 Plague Ready
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah! The plague is ready!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 28 Plague Fog Spread
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Death to the living!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 28 Plague Fog Spread
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I believe the Apothecarium is secure. Feel free to scurry along.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 28 Plague Fog Spread
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re welcome, Putress.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 29 Varimathras Die Zealots
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Die, you pitiful zealots!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 30 Varimathras Deal With
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: I will deal with the rest of these vermin. Get to the Mage Quarter!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 31 Months Of Construction
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Months of construction, undone in moments. These fanatics will pay.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 31 Months Of Construction
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Undercity can always be rebuilt. What matters now is protecting our people.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 32 Pylon Looks Similar
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek, that pylon looks similar to the ones controlling the captives.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 32 Pylon Looks Similar
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then perhaps we can use it to control the minds of our foes.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 33 Magic Has No Hold
lines.speaker: Inquisitor
lines.text: Your dark magic has no hold on me! Suffer the Light’s judgment!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 34 Who Needs Magic
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmph. Who needs magic when a blade gets the job done?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 34 Who Needs Magic
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve secured the area. Let’s head for the Rogue Quarter.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 35 Scarled Crusade Will Purge
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade will purge your wretched kind!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 36 Infidels Must Be Purified
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Monsters! You must be purified!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 36 Infidels Must Be Purified
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek! Take cover!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 37 Lets Head For Center UC
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Let’s head for the center of the Undercity. We can survey the damage on the way.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 38 Attack Months Planning
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: An attack of this scale would have taken months of planning.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 38 Attack Months Planning
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: And a sizeable number of soldiers. They must have a stronghold nearby.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 39 Sylvanas Heavy Repair
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Trade Quarter is under heavy repair. Avoid it for now and head directly to the surface.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 40 Bernd Explosives Warning
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Be careful with those. Don’t want to get caught in the blast radius!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 41 Tunnels Are Abandoned
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These tunnels are old and abandoned. They must have been left empty for a long time.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 42 Scarlet Crusader Explosives
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Scarlet Crusaders! Kill them and plant the explosives!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 43 One Breach Down
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That’s one breach down. Let’s close the others.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 44 What Is This Place Ruins
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 44 What Is This Place Ruins
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I don’t know. But it’s ancient. Perhaps older than Lordaeron itself.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 45 Some Kind Of Altar
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s some kind of altar. And... I can feel it calling to me...

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 46 Bernd Quite The Adventure
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Sounds like that was quite the adventure. I wonder what else lies buried all around us.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 47 Scarlet Crusade More Than Bargain
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It seems the Scarlet Crusade found more than they bargained for.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Moments.Moments Dialogue 09 Putress Experiment Loose
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Take this serum with you. It will grant you temporary control of the lesser experiments.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 62 Putress Take This Serum
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Take this serum with you. It will grant you temporary control of the lesser experiments.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 47 Scarlet Crusade More Than Bargain
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We might have, too. Maybe the larger specimens could force that thing back into its cell.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 63 MISSING DIALOGUE
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We might have, too. Maybe the larger specimens could force that thing back into its cell.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 57 Its Weakened Flesh Golem
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's weakened! The other specimens should be able to push it back!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 58 No Wonder Scarlet Crus Fell
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No wonder the Scarlet Crusade fell to that monstrosity.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 59 Eliminate Putress Pet
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Looks like we had to eliminate Putress's little pet. Oh well.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 48 Putress Start New Specimen
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ll have to start a new specimen from scratch. Months of experimentation down the drain!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 49 Putress Study Specimen
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ll study that specimen later. No doubt slaying those Scarlet fools will result in valuable data.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 50 Lexington Realign Pylon
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, thank the Dark Lady you’re here! We need time to realign the runes on the pylon!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 50 Lexington Realign Pylon
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Keep that banshee from attacking us, and we can end this without bloodshed!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 60 Neednt Kill Banshee
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: You needn't kill the banshee, merely hold it at bay!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 61 Making Pylon Repair Progress
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: We're making progress on the repairs. Keep it up!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 62 Pylon Nearly Restored
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: The pylon is nearly restored!

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 51 Lexington Banshee Dead
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: No! If only we had worked faster, this fate could have been avoided.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 52 Lexington Banshee Success
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Excellent! I’ll have to reinforce these pylons in the future.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 53 Varimathras Banshee Turn In
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: I hear the screaming has ceased. Whatever you did to stop it, you’ve earned your reward.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 53 Varimathras Banshee Turn In
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How very generous of you.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 54 Sylvanas Preparations
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Make your preparations. Once we lay siege to the Scarlet Monastery, there will be no turning back.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 55 Bernd So Much To Rebuild
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: It'll take weeks to repair the damage the Scarlet Crusade has done. I'd better get to work.

lines.scene: ========= Cinematics and Transmissions ==========.Dialogues.Dialogues - Transmissions.Transmissions Dialogue 56 Putress All The Blood Could Find
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Hmm, is that all the blood you could find? I suppose a small sample is better than none.
